business_problem: Sky Airline had to migrate its booking experience to Sabre without downtime while keeping customer, ticketing, and flight data accessible across 15 clusters and preserving security during ongoing growth.
solution_summary: Sky Airline uses MongoDB Atlas as the data backbone for content management, basic search, and e-commerce services that support its booking experience. During migration to Sabre, the airline had to keep 15 data clusters available so customers and staff could continue accessing ticketing, flight, and profile data without interruption. Atlas's document model let the team run the same workloads across on-premises and cloud environments, while MongoDB Compass gave engineers a consistent way to inspect data during production passes. Atlas also automated credential renewal around releases, reducing security risk as transaction peaks and version upgrades continued. The result was a host migration with zero downtime and post-migration Atlas version updates that complete in under 10 minutes, preserving always-on customer access.
